episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After Nam Gi Suk's mysterious death, Nam Gi Jun emerges from seclusion on a mission to find the perpetrator — no matter the cost.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After tracking down Gi Suk's hit, Gi Joon discovers the scheme's origin — forcing him to enforce a rule he established more than a decade ago.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Despite his father's precautions, Gu Jun Mo underestimates the threat he faces. Frustrated and desperate, he decides to handle Gi Jun himself.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Desperate to save his son, Chairman Gu digs deeper into Gi Suk's hit. After Jun Mo attacks his friends, Gi Jun goes head-to-head with Jun Mo's army.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Gi-jun quickly learns that his problems don't end with Jun-mo. A gang war breaks out after Chairman Lee suspects the real architect behind recent events.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Cha Young Do sets his plan in motion. As Lee Geum Son seizes power, Gi Jun faces betrayal, danger, and a race to uncover the truth behind it all.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: With all his obstacles cleared, Geum Son puts his endgame into play. Will Gi Jun succeed in stopping him, or go down trying?
